questions.stem_text:
The rest mass of a particle with total energy 5.0 GeV and momentum 4.9 GeV/c is
approximately

The mean kinetic energy of the conduction electrons in metals is ordinarily much higher
than kT because

options.A: electrons have many more degrees of freedom than atoms do
options.B: the electrons and the lattice are not in thermal equilibrium
options.C: the electrons form a degenerate Fermi gas
options.D: electrons in metals are highly relativistic

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the electrons form a degenerate Fermi gas

questions.stem_text: During a reversible thermodynamic process, the internal energy of the system changes significantly.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'The entropy of the system and its environment remains unchanged.'.

questions.stem_text: An observer moving at 0.50 c will measure the rod's length as 0.80 m, assuming no relativistic effects.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: '0.60 c'.

questions.stem_text: The primary source of the Sun's energy is thermonuclear reactions involving two hydrogen atoms and one helium atom.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'four hydrogen atoms and one helium atom'.

questions.stem_text: The electric displacement current through a surface S is proportional to the rate of change of the magnetic flux through S.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'rate of change of the electric flux through S'.

questions.stem_text: A photon detector with a quantum efficiency of 0.1 will detect exactly 10 photons out of 100 sent into it.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'an average of 10 times, with an rms deviation of about 3'.
